entries.name: AppShell
entries.purpose: The frame of an app, in the two manners that pair: `solid` — the structured frame, a solid TopBar over a Sidebar and the content beside it — and `floating` — the TopBar floating over the top edge, a Rail standing on the background, and the content living in the rounded card.

entries.name: AttachmentCard
entries.purpose: Something attached — a document or an image — drawn as a card: posted, or waiting to be sent.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.purpose: A person's face: their picture, or their initials on a colour that is theirs, or — when there is no name to take initials from — a silhouette.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: AvatarGroup
entries.purpose: Up to three overlapping 24px faces with a surface-coloured ring — the member stack for anywhere a group is shown at a glance.

entries.name: Banner
entries.purpose: The strip under the header where the app says something happened: one line, one of four tones, gone when there is nothing to say.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.purpose: A trail: where you are, and the way back up.

entries.name: Button
entries.purpose: The push-button for an action: a verb, clicked once — "Create", "Save", "Delete project".

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology
Is reachable with Tab

entries.name: Card
entries.purpose: A box that stands for one thing — drawn as its frame: 8px corners, a fill and a hairline.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.purpose: A 16px square that fills with the accent when checked.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Chip
entries.purpose: A 20px pill for a small piece of standing information — a status, a count, a category — in one of six colour types.

entries.name: ChipInput
entries.purpose: A multi-select input: chips for the chosen, a typeahead for the rest.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: cn
entries.purpose: Merge class names, last-one-wins on conflicting Tailwind utilities.

entries.name: CollapsibleSection
entries.purpose: A section that opens and closes: a SectionHeader whose title is the toggle, and the rows under it, sliding shut and open.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: CommandPalette
entries.purpose: A window that searches and runs things: a field, rows in groups, and a footer naming the keys that work right now.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Holds focus inside while open, and gives it back
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: CommandPaletteAnswer
entries.purpose: A written answer, with marks that point at the rows it came from.

entries.name: CommandPaletteForm
entries.purpose: The palette as a form: fields, one submit button, and Ctrl+Enter — both ways in run Base UI's field check.

entries.name: CommandPaletteQuote
entries.purpose: Text written to be used elsewhere, set off by a rule at its left edge.

entries.name: CommandPaletteSearch
entries.purpose: The palette as a search: a query field, rows in labelled groups walked with the arrow keys, and what to show while nothing has arrived and when nothing matches.

entries.name: CommandPaletteWorking
entries.purpose: A line saying what is being worked on, with grey bars where the result will land.

entries.name: ConfirmDialog
entries.purpose: A question with two answers, asked before something a person would want back.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: DialogShell
entries.purpose: The dialog, minus what it says: the portal, the backdrop, a 502px card, a 48px header with the title and a close button, a body, and a 48px footer for the buttons.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Closes on a press outside
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Holds focus inside while open, and gives it back
Stops the page behind it scrolling
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Divider
entries.purpose: A hairline in `border-subtle`. Horizontal it is inset 12px each side; `orientation="vertical"` stands it up to its row's height, no inset.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: EditableText
entries.purpose: Text you click to edit. It reads as text until clicked; then it is a field.

entries.name: EmptyState
entries.purpose: The place where content will be once there is some, in two manners: a 16px icon over a centred line when the whole page is empty, the line alone and left-aligned when one section of a page is.

entries.name: EnterHint
entries.purpose: The keyboard hint a picker row shows while highlighted — hand-rolled in five files before this (2026-09-01), and drawn as its own thing until 2026-09-05, when it became the `Kbd` chip every other key hint uses.

entries.name: Field
entries.purpose: A label over a control — the form row. The label is the `input-label` token; `required` marks it with the error-coloured asterisk.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: FieldLine
entries.purpose: The small line a Field draws under a control — on its own, for the places where there is no single control to draw it under.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: FilePicker
entries.purpose: The browser's file picker, with nothing drawn.

entries.name: Form
entries.purpose: The fields and the button that sends them.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: hueFor
entries.purpose: The colour a person's initials sit on, chosen from a key: the same key always gives the same hue, so a face reads as theirs in every app.

entries.name: IconButton
entries.purpose: A square button around a 16px icon: 4px padding, 8px radius, three variants.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology
Is reachable with Tab

entries.name: IdentityMenu
entries.purpose: Who you are, and where you are: the identity trigger for a top bar, and the menu it opens — ready-made, because every app needs one and it is built of nothing but shared parts.

entries.name: IdentityPanel
entries.purpose: The identity rows on a panel of their own, with no menu around them — for a docs page, or anywhere the panel is already placed.

entries.name: initialsFor
entries.purpose: Peek's rule, sharpened: the first letter of the first two words — counting only words that begin with a letter or digit, so "Claude (steered by Katerina Kelepouri)" shows "C", never "C(" (Katerina, 2026-09-01: a name carrying such symbols gets a single letter rather than one of them).

entries.name: INLINE_CHIP_CLASSES
entries.purpose: The shape every tone shares. Exported for a rich-text editor that renders chips from strings.

entries.name: INLINE_CHIP_TONE_CLASSES
entries.purpose: What a chip is made of, by what it stands for.

entries.name: InlineChip
entries.purpose: A word in a sentence that stands for something — a person, a place, a thing — drawn as a small tinted box exactly one line high, with its words level with the text around it.

entries.name: inlineChipClassName
entries.purpose: The chip's classes for a tone, with anything the caller adds.

entries.name: InputChip
entries.purpose: A chip standing on its own: a label, an optional leading icon, an optional ✕.

entries.name: Kbd
entries.purpose: The small chip that names the key which does the same thing.

entries.name: Link
entries.purpose: A link, in one of four looks. It is a real anchor with a real address, and the app decides how it navigates.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Says what it is to assistive technology
Is reachable with Tab

entries.name: Menu
entries.purpose: A list of actions from a trigger. The menu owns the trigger, so a caller writes no open state, no placement and no dismiss — it hands over the control and the rows, and everything else is Base UI's.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Closes on a press outside
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Stays attached to its anchor on scroll and resize
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: MenuItem
entries.purpose: The row of a menu: label, and around it everything a row can carry — a `leading` icon or face, a `description` second line, a `shortcut` kbd chip, a `submenu` chevron, a `trailing` anything (which wins over the other two), `destructive` in the error colour, `selected` as the fill.

entries.name: MenuPanel
entries.purpose: The menu's surface without the menu: the elevated box, the rows' padding, and a divider that runs the full width of what it separates.

entries.name: MenuRow
entries.purpose: A non-interactive row inside a menu, at the item's own geometry.

entries.name: MenuSection
entries.purpose: A section heading inside a menu: the 32px row with a SectionLabel, read secondary — a heading inside a menu labels the rows, it is not one of them (Katerina, 2026-09-01).

entries.name: MenuSub
entries.purpose: A row that opens another menu beside it; its rows are this row's children.

entries.name: NavItem
entries.purpose: One row of a sidebar: an optional 16px icon, a label, and an optional count — a muted mono number whose tooltip says what it counts.

entries.name: Person
entries.purpose: A face beside a name — the inline mention of a human.

entries.name: PersonTrigger
entries.purpose: The person, as the button that opens a menu.

entries.name: Popover
entries.purpose: A floating panel from a trigger: the same elevated surface a Menu draws, with none of a menu's semantics.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Closes on a press outside
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Stays attached to its anchor on scroll and resize

entries.name: PreviewCard
entries.purpose: More of a thing, on hover.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Closes on a press outside
Stays attached to its anchor on scroll and resize

entries.name: ProgressBar
entries.purpose: How much of something is done: a thin rounded track with a success-coloured fill.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Property
entries.purpose: A labelled property — "Status", "Lead", and whatever else a surface declares.

entries.name: Rail
entries.purpose: The 64px strip of icon tiles down the left of an app.

entries.name: RailItem
entries.purpose: One tile of an icon rail: the icon in its hover tile, a 9px label under it.

entries.name: Reaction
entries.purpose: An emoji, how many people chose it, and whether you are one of them.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: ReactionPicker
entries.purpose: The reactions on offer, to choose one from — icon buttons holding emoji, on a Toolbar.

entries.name: ScrollArea
entries.purpose: A region that scrolls without taking width for its scrollbar.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Scrolls with our scrollbar

entries.name: SearchInput
entries.purpose: An inset field with a hairline border that strengthens on hover and on focus, and an optional keyboard hint at the right edge.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: SectionHeader
entries.purpose: The 32px row a section starts with: a SectionLabel, and actions that appear on hover or focus as IconButtons with tooltips.

entries.name: SectionLabel
entries.purpose: The section-title span. Every section heading — sidebar sections, menu headings, panel titles — renders through it, so a change of voice is one edit. 12px / 500, primary text; some themes restyle it (the toolbar shows how).

entries.name: Select
entries.purpose: One value for a form field: a button that shows the choice and opens a portalled listbox under itself.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Closes on a press outside
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Stays attached to its anchor on scroll and resize
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Sidebar
entries.purpose: The navigation column: 240px, a hairline on its right, the surface behind it, scrolling independently of the content beside it.

entries.name: SkeletonBar
entries.purpose: One pulsing bar at the inset colour: the piece every placeholder here is built from.

entries.name: SkeletonList
entries.purpose: Rows of varied widths, so the placeholder does not read as a pattern.

entries.name: SkeletonRow
entries.purpose: A 32px row: a 16px square and a bar, like a row with a face and a name.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.purpose: A row of tabs for switching between views of one thing.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: Textarea
entries.purpose: TextInput's look on a multi-line field that does not resize.

entries.name: TextInput
entries.purpose: The single-line field: inset surface, 8px radius, 14px text, a stronger border on hover, the focus border in every theme.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI

entries.name: Toast
entries.purpose: A pill that says what just happened — three types, an optional leading check, an optional action — and ToastProvider/useToast, which own the positioning (bottom-left), the portal, and the auto-dismiss.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: ToastProvider
entries.purpose: Mount once, near the top of an app. It owns the stack, the timers and the portal every toast goes through, and it is what `useToast` talks to.

entries.name: Toolbar
entries.purpose: A strip of controls that behaves as one control: Tab in, arrow keys along, Tab out — on the elevated box a floating strip needs.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Closes on Escape, and takes its keys, by itself
Moves through its items with the arrow keys
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: ToolbarButton
entries.purpose: An `IconButton` that is an item of a `Toolbar`: the arrow keys reach it, and a disabled one stays in the walk so its reason can still be read.

entries.name: ToolbarInput
entries.purpose: A `TextInput` that is an item of a `Toolbar`, so the arrow keys walk into the field and out of it again.

entries.name: ToolbarSeparator
entries.purpose: The hairline between two groups of controls.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.purpose: A 30px elevated pill with a caption, and WithTooltip, the wrapper that shows it beside a trigger — on hover, and on keyboard focus.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Floats on top of the page
Stays attached to its anchor on scroll and resize
Says what it is to assistive technology

entries.name: TooltipProvider
entries.purpose: Mount once at the top of an app: it makes every tooltip below it share one delay, so the second and third open instantly while the group is warm.

entries.name: TopBar
entries.purpose: The 52px top bar: `menu` and `logo` on the left, a `search` slot in the centre, the identity cluster on the right.

entries.name: useToast
entries.purpose: How anything under a `ToastProvider` raises a toast (`showToast`) or takes one away (`dismissToast`).

entries.name: WithTooltip
entries.purpose: A tooltip on something that cannot be its own trigger — a span, a `Chip`, an icon.

ownsBehaviours.behaviour: Is built on Base UI
Says what it is to assistive technology
